name: Bullet Hose
description: Quantity has a quality of its own. Keeps Twin Barrel's multiplied bullets in every shot, with a much faster trigger.
details: Formed from Twin Barrel and Rapid Cycler. It keeps Twin Barrel's doubling (1 bullet becomes 2, 2 become 4, after all your other cards) and adds a much faster trigger and a bigger magazine. Each bullet hits softer.
